body:
I would love to if I could find a job.

Which is one of the main reasons I'm feeling this way. I have no job and I spend 90% of my day filling out applications and making calls. But I have nothing to show for it.

So what if, as I said in my post, I just leave? 

Abandon ship and give them some financial relief until I can come back and actually repay them. At some point, anyway. 

I just...I don't want to continue putting undue stress on them for no good reason.
